version: Team values, added after PRD Rev C (scope change 3B)
note: Body-system rules give Advisory or Caution only. They never give Warning. They do not count toward the radiation alarm budget (M-3). Thresholds are team values for the demo. They are not NASA flight rules. A crew member can set a stricter personal limit for each value under "personal": [loosest, strictest, step, unit, label]. The loosest value is the team value.

rules.title: Radiation sickness signs
rules.text: Nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea within {windowH} h after an event dose above {minEventMSv} mSv. Tell the CMO now.
rules.basis: Team value, below the onset of acute radiation sickness (about 1,000 mSv whole body). Below it, nausea has a more likely cause, such as space motion sickness.

rules.title: Vision change
rules.text: Blurred near vision or eye pressure. Do the near-vision check at the next exam.

rules.title: Vision change continues
rules.text: Vision symptoms on 2 days in a row. Ask the CMO for an eye exam.

rules.title: CO2 headache
rules.text: Headache with a stuffy head, short breath, or dizziness. Check the cabin CO2 reading.

rules.title: Short sleep
rules.text: Sleep under {underH} h on {nights} of the last {nights} check-ins. Talk to the CMO about the sleep plan.

rules.title: Low mood
rules.text: Mood {atOrBelow} of 5 or lower on {count} of the last {of} check-ins. A private talk with the CMO or the flight psychologist can help.

rules.title: Resting heart rate out of range
rules.text: Resting heart rate is above {highBpm} or below {lowBpm} bpm. Tell the CMO now.

rules.title: Resting heart rate rise
rules.text: Resting heart rate is more than {riseBpm} bpm above your 7-day mean.

rules.title: Low exercise
rules.text: Exercise under {minPerDay} min a day on {count} of the last {of} days. Exercise slows bone and muscle loss.

rules.title: Bruising or bleeding
rules.text: Easy bruising or bleeding gums. Tell the CMO.
